chunks: With this chain of narrators, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Isma'il ibn Mahran, from Salih ibn Sa'id, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), that he said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) said: Manliness (al-muru'ah) is the rectification/consolidation of property.

key_terms.اسْتِصْلَاحُ: Rectification, consolidation, or making something sound/secure.
key_terms.الْمُرُوءَةُ: Manliness, masculine virtue, or the quality of being a mature, honorable man.

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of manliness (muru'ah) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this chain linking Imam al-Sadiq to the Prophet, defining *al-muru'ah* (masculine virtue) through the lens of financial prudence and wealth preservation. This interpretation shifts the concept from mere physical bravery to the responsible stewardship of resources, reflecting the Shia emphasis on economic independence as a prerequisite for moral integrity and social dignity.

en.basel-kadem: 6.	With this chain of narrators, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from Isma’eel bin Mahran, from Saleh bin Sa’eed, from Aban bin Taghlib, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, that he said:
The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Manliness is to seek rectification of property.
